ideas.pitch: A multi-agent system that ingests production alerts, queries logs via MCP, coordinates root-cause analysis, and opens PR fixes autonomously.
ideas.title: Agentic Incident Command
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the developer productivity and autonomous debugging angle proved successful at the IBM Bob Dev Day Hackathon by turning runtime errors into structured repair plans.

ideas.pitch: An agentic RAG and Model Context Protocol server that indexes and cross-references fragmented college event guidelines, timetables, and academic policies.
ideas.title: Federated Campus Doc Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leveraging federated MCP servers creates high architectural complexity that impresses judges looking for deep systems engineering, mirroring the MCP & AI Agents Hackathon runner-up.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end IT support agent that ingests Discord or Slack student queries, auto-triages campus IT tickets, runs diagnostic scripts, and requests admin sign-off.
ideas.title: Autonomous ITSM Triage Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses immediate administrative headaches faced by student organisers and college authorities during major fests, following the practical workflow patterns of the Microsoft Agent Academy winner.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI code review agent designed to analyze git diffs locally using lightweight models without leaking proprietary student hackathon source code.
ideas.title: Edge Agent Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an offline local AI paradigm which aligns with the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon winner by emphasizing privacy, speed, and local hardware utilization.

ideas.pitch: A natural language agent that plans, scaffolds, and generates functional multi-page React or Expo applications on the fly from simple prompt descriptions.
ideas.title: Meta-App Builder Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an impressive live-demo impact where an agent constructs software in real-time, matching the successful strategy of the STRV Hackathon winner.
